title: Preserve catalog cases after Markdown comments
summary: The v0.0.4.75 hardening draft keeps raw HTML markers inside Markdown comments from hiding visible catalog cases that follow. The check ran against the prior integration base recorded in PR #40.
acceptance_criteria: Register both visible tables when the intervening Markdown comment contains a raw HTML marker.
Keep actual HTML examples and comment-only cases out of the executable inventory.

evidence.claim: The inventory and adoption job ran the tooling regression suite on the .75 candidate checkout.
